overview_description.description:
Tmyyoz is an electronic educational platform that provides educational and technical resources to students.

Tmyyoz was designed to create an enhanced educational experience and assist students in preparing for standardized tests and excelling in their academic curricula, in collaboration with specialized instructors and educators.

It was founded in 2021 and is based in Makkah, Alawali.

product.name: منصة تميز (Tmyyoz Platform)
product.description: An electronic educational platform offering comprehensive resources and training for students to pass standardized tests.

product.name: دورات قدرات (Qudrat Courses)
product.description: Courses designed to help students prepare for the Qudrat test, covering both scientific and literary tracks.

product.name: اختبارات محاكية للقدرات (Simulated Qudrat Tests)
product.description: Simulated tests to help students practice and prepare for the Qudrat test.

product.name: دورات تحصيلي (Tahsili Courses)
product.description: Courses aimed at preparing students for the Tahsili test, covering both scientific and literary subjects.

product.name: اختبارات محاكية للتحصيلي (Simulated Tahsili Tests)
product.description: Simulated tests to help students practice and prepare for the Tahsili test.

product.name: قدرات الجامعيين (University Qudrat)
product.description: Courses to prepare university students for the Qudrat test, including foundational and training materials.
